span.p: 3. Three evidence paths for late-death rescue

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(36, 69, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Field-collapse path
time >= 72 h / at least 4 of 5 signals:
cell count, cell area, cytoplasm area,
red mass, mask-covered fraction

div.style: color: rgb(36, 69, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Field consensus
>= 75% sites agree
enter after 3 persistent frames
recover after 3 frames with <= 1 signal
both branches must confirm collapse

div.style: color: rgb(36, 69, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Object multisignal path
high nuclear/cytoplasm ratio
area/cytoplasm depletion / red loss
round/solid shape / cell-conditioned Dead signal

div.style: color: rgb(36, 69, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Object consensus
percentile >= 0.50 in at least 2 groups
fewer than 3 strong-live groups
matched partner <= 10 px: both branches agree
unmatched: at least 3 death groups

div.style: color: rgb(36, 69, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Temporal-remnant path
previously supported death followed by signal loss
confident track / at least 2 supporting frames
no strong-live evidence / branch support
